Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p> </p> <h4>🙌 What’s in it for you</h4> <p>💰 £125,000 - £145,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ equity</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role is hybrid working from our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</h4> <ul> <li>First stage - Meet with our Collective Product Director</li> <li>Second stage - Meet with our Engineering and Finance leadership</li> <li>Third stage - Product full loop</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. You'll be a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, and you'll be excellent at navigating a complex, stakeholder-heavy environment to get things done.</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Martech & AI and sits within the Martech team, part of the Growth Collective. This is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be involved in:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Programme management:</strong> Leading our content scaling programme including translating goals into sequenced, actionable work, driving delivery, and coordinating owners and stakeholders across a complex environment.</p> <p><strong>Building AI agents:</strong> Designing and building AI agents (using tools like Claude) to transform how we produce and scale content. This means turning repeatable, manual work into reliable, well-governed automated flows, with clear judgement on where a human stays in the loop.</p> <p><strong>Systems integration and governance:</strong> Connecting AI and agents into our martech stack and data to unlock new capabilities. This means building the integrations that make them work, and doing it safely in a regulated, financial-services environment (i.e. with data protection, compliance, and the right controls built in).</p> <p><strong>Creative AI tooling:</strong> Running discovery on creative AI tooling. You've led cross-functional programmes or workstreams end to end, sequencing the work, managing dependencies and risk, keeping stakeholders aligned, and driving delivery to a successful outcome (including picking up work already in flight).</li> <li>You're a first-principles and systems thinker who can break down a complex, ambiguous problem, design how the parts fit together, and build a solution.</li> <li>You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and in complex, stakeholder-heavy environments, working with individuals at all levels to get things done.</li> <li>You have a working understanding of marketing and how content and creative are produced. You know what "good" needs to look like and how to build the right guardrails around it.</li> <li>You bring martech literacy and can run a rigorous tooling selection process. This means familiarity with the tooling, integrations, data, and vendors that make up a marketing tech stack. </li> <li>You're comfortable building and integrating AI in a regulated or high-governance environment. You design for data protection, compliance, and the right human controls from the start, not as an afterthought.</li> <li>You possess excellent communication skills, translating between the business need and the technical detail so everyone's working to the same picture.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p>At Monzo, our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Technical Program Manager</strong> to help ship more and better payment product offerings. This is a high-impact role that demands both technical expertise and exceptional leadership to drive our ambitious goals.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of launching payment products that cross multiple teams and disciplines</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programs: <ul> <li>Define program roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers and speed up delivery</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience managing complex technology programs or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You are able to communicate clearly and persuasively to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership</li> <li>You are comfortable in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be a part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and identify/mitigate delivery risks proactively; can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data and architecture to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-NB2</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Global Payroll Manager
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>Global Payroll Manager</strong>, ideally a candidate who thrives on building scalable systems, automating manual processes, and creating operational excellence in a high growth technology environment. </p> <p>We are looking for a leader who combines deep payroll expertise with a systems oriented mindset. You should be passionate about process improvement, automation, and leveraging technology to increase accuracy, efficiency, transparency, and employee satisfaction. Experience supporting a remote, international workforce is highly valued, as is a genuine interest in the software and technology industry.</p> <p>This is a management position which requires confidence in setting direction, driving excellence, managing priorities, developing team members, and communicating effectively with stakeholders across the business. As we continue to grow globally, you will play a key role in scaling our payroll infrastructure and raising the standard for operational excellence. This role will report to the Global Financial Controller.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. </p> <p><strong>The role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with HR, Accounting, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Financial Planning & Analysis, and external payroll providers to support payroll operations and compliance</li> <li>Manage end-to-end payroll operations across different countries, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing</li> <li>Review, validate, and approve payrolls prior to final processing</li> <li>Establish and maintain strong payroll controls to ensure data accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency</li> <li>Perform payroll and salary cost analyses, investigating and explaining variances</li> <li>Ensure compliance with all applicable payroll tax, statutory, reporting, and employment-related requirements across jurisdictions </li> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll-related audits, coordinating responses to internal and external audit requests</li> <li>Monitor legislative and regulatory changes that may impact payroll processes, controls, or compliance obligations</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance payroll accuracy, scalability, and the employee experience</li> <li>Continue to develop, document, and maintain payroll policies, procedures, and internal controls</li> <li>Maintain strong relationships with payroll vendors and service providers, ensuring service levels and deliverables are met</li> <li>Incorporate industry best practices, emerging technology, including AI, to improve reporting quality, efficiency, and accuracy</li> <li>Lead, mentor and coach a team of global payroll professionals</li> <li>Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements while identifying and managing compliance risks.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Accounting or Finance, or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path</li> <li>Significant payroll experience supporting multi-country and/or global payroll operations</li> <li>Strong knowledge of payroll compliance, taxation, and internal controls</li> <li>Experience managing payroll audits and regulatory requirements</li> <li>Proficiency with payroll systems, HRIS platforms, and spreadsheet-based analysis</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills</li> <li>Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship</li> <li>The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues</li> <li>A track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization</li> <li>Thoughtfulness and self-motivation</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience implementing or optimizing payroll platforms and HRIS systems</li> <li>Payroll management experience in publicly traded or pre-IPO companies</li> <li>A passion for technology and a desire to work with motivated colleagues</li> <li>Experience supporting rapid expansion, including new country payroll launches</li> <li>A passion for technology and a desire to work with motivated colleagues</li> <li>MBA or other relevant business degree</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Manager -London
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business. You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders. The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance. You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA. - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development. - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover. - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion. - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows. - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization. - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership. - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities. - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions. - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery. - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions. - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems. - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans. - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments. - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders. - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs. NICE TO HAVES - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment. - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows. - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration. - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling. - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs. - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts. - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up. - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions. title: Accounts Payable Clerk
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team. </p> <p>Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/P ledgers, process supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, prepare supplier payments, deal with queries effectively and efficiently and maintain compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development including offering you with support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <h3><strong>A day in the life of an Accounts Payable Clerk</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/P ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our vendor data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of vendor data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Prepare our supplier payments in line with the payments timetable and presented for approval in a clear and organised format</li> <li>Identify payments properly withheld, monitored and released when approval given</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: prepayments, accruals, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will bring to the role</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, look ups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organisation skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an exterprise level accounting system </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li>Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Cloud Support Engineer (London UK office)
description: <p>This is an opportunity to kickstart your career by joining Canonical. You will be working from our Canonical London Office and will be accountable for delivering technical support to our employees and customers, as well as facilitating AV support for office conferences and events. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers.  If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
